longName: Confirm the Annual IDEA Environments - School Age Methodology Responses for FS002
scope: The SEA's process of confirming/updating its FS5003 methodology responses through to Ready to Submit in EDPass. Out of scope: submission (parent); FS5002; FS002 compilation (sibling).
frequency: Annually, per SEA, typically parallel with FS002 Compilation.

actors.role: Operates the FS5003 form; runs to Ready to Submit; updates the audit record.
actors.interest: Responses ready, signed off, consistent with the in-flight file.

actors.role: Substantive owner of the methodology; provides authoritative responses; signs off.
actors.interest: Responses reflect current policy and survive year over year.

actors.actor: SEA IDEA Part B Data Manager
actors.role: Flags inconsistencies between stated methodology and the methodology applied in the in-flight compilation.
Runs heuristic checks for likely cross-file BRSI failures.
actors.interest: Cross-file issues caught at the SEA before EDPass.

assumes.statement: The current FS5003 metadata collection is open in EDPass and the Coordinator has active access.
ED revisions to the questionnaire since the prior cycle have been identified.
The SEA's current IDEA Educational Environment policy is documented and accessible.

story.action: confirms the FS5003 collection is open in EDPass and reviews ED revisions to the questionnaire since the prior cycle
story.intention: know what must be answered this cycle

consumes.name: Current FS5003 questionnaire
consumes.role: the complete set of questions requiring response

story.action: retrieves the prior-year FS5003 responses as the baseline
story.intention: a starting point for rollover/change detection

story.action: reviews prior responses against current SEA policy, assigning each question a disposition (rolls forward / needs update / new)

consumes.name: Current SEA Educational Environment policy documents

story.action: for each question requiring update/new authoring, provides the substantive response (recorded by the Coordinator)
confirms each rolled-over prior response for the new cycle
reviews the responses against the in-flight FS002 Compilation, flagging gaps between methodology-as-stated and methodology-as-applied
runs a heuristic check for likely cross-file BRSI consistency between the responses and the FS002 environment dimension
story.intention: catch likely BRSI failures before EDPass

story.action: signs off on the complete set of responses
story.intention: the methodology is owned, not merely transcribed
story.benefit: the stated methodology is owned by policy leadership, not merely transcribed

story.action: marks the FS5003 collection Ready to Submit in EDPass

produces.role: the FS5003 Responses at Ready to Submit

story.action: updates the SEA's methodology audit record (what changed, who reviewed, when, what prompted changes)
story.intention: the stated methodology is traceable and defensible

scenario.condition: ED substantially revised the questionnaire, adding questions requiring decisions not yet made

story.action: escalates to the Policy / SpEd Director; decisions made; new questions answered; resume at step 4

scenario.condition: the Data Manager finds a response that does not match the methodology applied in compilation

story.action: Coordinator, Director, and Data Manager adjust the response, adjust compilation, or record a known limitation and prepare a data note for the parent

scenario.condition: the Director declines to sign off due to substantive concerns

story.action: resolves through additional review or re-authoring; sign-off obtained or the case is suspended

condition.statement: All required FS5003 questions have responses, signed off, and the collection is Ready to Submit in EDPass.
The methodology stated in the FS5003 responses is the methodology actually applied to produce the FS002 counts; no divergence between stated and applied practice survives confirmation.

subject.name: The FS5003 IDEA Environments - School Age Methodology Responses

governs.role: IDEA Educational Environment for School Age -- this case defines how it is populated
IDEA Educational Environment for Early Childhood (bridging cohort)

sourceDataRequired.name: State policy change records since the prior cycle
sourceDataRequired.origin: The SEA policy archive / general counsel
sourceDataRequired.role: identifies whether methodology changes are required

relatedUseCases.notes: applies the methodology this case states to compute the FS002 environment dimension
